select lin.linija_id                                   as id,
       vob.sifra                                       as sif_vrste,
       at1.sifra                                       as atr1,
       at1.naziv_sl                                    as atr1_opis,

       SDO_UTIL.TO_WKTGEOMETRY(case when lin.geom is null then null

           -- LINESTRING -> MULTILINESTRING
                                    when mod(lin.geom.sdo_gtype, 1000) = 2 then SDO_GEOMETRY(
                                            trunc(lin.geom.sdo_gtype / 1000) * 1000 + 6, lin.geom.sdo_srid, null,
                                            lin.geom.sdo_elem_info, lin.geom.sdo_ordinates)

           -- already MULTILINESTRING
                                    when mod(lin.geom.sdo_gtype, 1000) = 6 then lin.geom

                                    else lin.geom end) as geom,

       case when at1.sifra in (1, 2) then 1 -- CESTE --> AC
            when at1.sifra in (3, 4, 5, 6) then 2 -- CESTE --> I in II
           end                                         as vrsta_odd

from GJI.LINIJE lin
         left join sif.gji_vrste_objektov vob on lin.gji_vrsta_objekta_id = vob.gji_vrsta_objekta_id
         left join sif.gji_atr1 at1 on lin.gji_atr1_id = at1.gji_atr1_id
where lin.GJI_ATR1_ID in (14, 18, 7, 2, 3, 12)
order by atr1, id

with q as ( select lin.linija_id          as linija_id,
                   vob.sifra              as sif_vrste,
                   at2.sifra              as atr2,
                   at2.naziv_sl           as atr2_opis,

                   case when lin.geom is null then null

                       -- LINESTRING -> MULTILINESTRING
                        when mod(lin.geom.sdo_gtype, 1000) = 2 then SDO_GEOMETRY(
                                trunc(lin.geom.sdo_gtype / 1000) * 1000 + 6, lin.geom.sdo_srid, null,
                                lin.geom.sdo_elem_info, lin.geom.sdo_ordinates)

                       -- already MULTILINESTRING
                        when mod(lin.geom.sdo_gtype, 1000) = 6 then lin.geom

                        else lin.geom end as geom_sdo,

                   case when at2.sifra in (3) then 4 -- DALJNOVODI --> 110kV
                        when at2.sifra in (1, 2) then 5 -- DALJNOVODI --> nad 110kV
                       end                as vrsta_odd

                     left join sif.gji_atr2 at2 on lin.gji_atr2_id = at2.gji_atr2_id

       atr2,
